SELECT strftime('%Y', t.Date) AS year,
       SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS total_consumption
FROM "transactions_1k" t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c."customers_currency" = 'CZK'
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY total_consumption DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.customers_currency = 'CZK' GROUP BY SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) ORDER BY SUM(T2.yearmonth_consumption) DESC LIMIT 1

WITH consumption_by_segment_year AS (
  SELECT 
    c.Segment,
    strftime('%Y', t.Date) AS year,
    SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS total_consumption
  FROM "transactions_1k" t
  JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c."customers_currency" = 'EUR'
    AND strftime('%Y', t.Date) IN ('2012', '2013')
  GROUP BY c.Segment, strftime('%Y', t.Date)
),
pivot_consumption AS (
  SELECT 
    Segment,
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN total_consumption END) AS consumption_2012,
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN total_consumption END) AS consumption_2013
  FROM consumption_by_segment_year
  GROUP BY Segment
  HAVING consumption_2012 > 0 AND consumption_2013 > 0
),
percentage_increase AS (
  SELECT 
    Segment,
    (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) / consumption_2012 * 100 AS pct_increase
  FROM pivot_consumption
  WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
)
SELECT 
  Segment,
  pct_increase
FROM percentage_increase
WHERE pct_increase = (SELECT MAX(pct_increase) FROM percentage_increase)
   OR pct_increase = (SELECT MIN(pct_increase) FROM percentage_increase)
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC

SELECT 
    c.Segment,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', t.Date) = '2013' AND c.customers_currency = 'EUR' THEN t.Amount * t.Price ELSE 0 END) -
     SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', t.Date) = '2012' AND c.customers_currency = 'EUR' THEN t.Amount * t.Price ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', t.Date) = '2012' AND c.customers_currency = 'EUR' THEN t.Amount * t.Price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS percentage_increase
FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  AND strftime('%Y', t.Date) IN ('2012', '2013')
GROUP BY c.Segment
HAVING percentage_increase IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    Segment,
    ((SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2013' THEN yearmonth_consumption ELSE 0 END) - 
      SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2012' THEN yearmonth_consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / 
     NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2012' THEN yearmonth_consumption ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS percentage_increase
FROM customers 
INNER JOIN yearmonth ON customers.CustomerID = yearmonth.CustomerID
WHERE customers_currency = 'EUR' 
  AND (strftime('%Y', Date) = '2012' OR strftime('%Y', Date) = '2013')
  AND Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
GROUP BY Segment
ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC

JOIN "League" l ON m.league_id = l.id
JOIN "Country" c ON l.country_id = c.id
JOIN "Team" t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE c.name = 'Scotland' AND l.name LIKE '%Premier%' AND m.season = '2010' AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal

WITH highest_avg_salary_branch AS (
    SELECT d.district_id
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
    LIMIT 1
),
accounts_in_branch AS (
    SELECT a.account_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN highest_avg_salary_branch h ON a.district_id = h.district_id
),
oldest_client_in_branch AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.sex, c.nativity_daystamp,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.nativity_daystamp ASC) as age_rank
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN accounts_in_branch a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
)
SELECT sex
FROM oldest_client_in_branch
WHERE age_rank = 1

WITH NormalRange AS (
  SELECT 
    p.ID,
    p."field_001" AS gender,
    l.CRE,
    CASE 
      WHEN l.CRE < 0.6 OR l.CRE > 1.2 THEN 'abnormal'
      ELSE 'normal'
    END AS cre_status
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.CRE IS NOT NULL AND p."field_001" IN ('male', 'female')
),
GenderCounts AS (
  SELECT 
    gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS abnormal_count
  FROM NormalRange
  WHERE cre_status = 'abnormal'
  GROUP BY gender
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN 
      (SELECT abnormal_count FROM GenderCounts WHERE gender = 'male') >
      (SELECT abnormal_count FROM GenderCounts WHERE gender = 'female')
    THEN 'True'
    ELSE 'False'
  END

        s.cname AS county_name,
        s.sname AS school_name,
        s.AvgScrRead,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.cname ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rank_in_county
    FROM satscores s
    JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
    WHERE sc.Virtual = 'Y'

SELECT satscores.AvgScrMath, frpm.`County Name`
FROM satscores
JOIN frpm ON satscores.cds = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.cds = (
    SELECT cds
    FROM (
        SELECT cds, (COALESCE(AvgScrRead, 0) + COALESCE(AvgScrMath, 0) + COALESCE(AvgScrWrite, 0)) / 
               (CASE WHEN AvgScrRead IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + 
                CASE WHEN AvgScrMath IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + 
                CASE WHEN AvgScrWrite IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS avg_all_subjects
        FROM satscores
        WHERE rtype = 'S'
    )
    WHERE avg_all_subjects IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY avg_all_subjects ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
AND satscores.rtype = 'S'
LIMIT 1

WITH race_numbers AS (
    SELECT 
        raceId,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY year, round) AS race_number
    FROM races
),
di_resta_races AS (
    SELECT 
        r.raceId,
        rn.race_number,
        res.fastestLapSpeed
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN results res ON d.driverId = res.driverId
    JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN race_numbers rn ON r.raceId = rn.raceId
    WHERE d.driverRef = 'di_resta'
        AND res.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL
        AND res.fastestLapSpeed != ''
),
target_race AS (
    SELECT 
        race_number,
        fastestLapSpeed
    FROM di_resta_races
    WHERE race_number = 853
),
next_race AS (
    SELECT 
        dr.race_number,
        dr.fastestLapSpeed
    FROM di_resta_races dr
    WHERE dr.race_number > 853
    ORDER BY dr.race_number
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN t.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL AND n.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL 
            THEN ((CAST(t.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) - CAST(n.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) / CAST(n.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) * 100
        ELSE NULL
    END AS percent_faster
FROM target_race t
CROSS JOIN next_race n

WITH HamiltonRaces AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.year, r.circuitId, c.name AS circuitName,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY r.round) AS race_order_in_year
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
    JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    WHERE d.driverRef LIKE '%hamilton%' AND r.year >= 2010
),
FirstRaceEachYear AS (
    SELECT r.year, MIN(r.round) AS first_round
    FROM races r
    WHERE r.year >= 2010
    GROUP BY r.year
),
HamiltonFirstRaceParticipation AS (
    SELECT hr.year,
           CASE WHEN hr.race_order_in_year = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS participated_in_first_race
    FROM HamiltonRaces hr
    JOIN FirstRaceEachYear fr ON hr.year = fr.year AND hr.race_order_in_year = 1
)
SELECT 
    (COUNT(*) - SUM(participated_in_first_race)) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_not_at_first_track
FROM HamiltonFirstRaceParticipation

WITH lap_times_in_seconds AS (
    SELECT 
        driverId,
        (CASE 
            WHEN INSTR(time, ':') > 0 THEN CAST(SUBSTR(time, 1, INSTR(time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 
            ELSE 0 
        END + 
        CASE 
            WHEN INSTR(time, ':') > 0 AND INSTR(time, '.') > INSTR(time, ':') THEN 
                CAST(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, ':') + 1, INSTR(time, '.') - INSTR(time, ':') - 1) AS REAL)
            ELSE 0 
        END + 
        CASE 
            WHEN INSTR(time, '.') > 0 THEN CAST(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS time_in_seconds
    FROM lapTimes
    WHERE time IS NOT NULL
),
driver_min_lap AS (
    SELECT 
        driverId,
        MIN(time_in_seconds) AS min_time_in_seconds
    FROM lap_times_in_seconds
    GROUP BY driverId
)
SELECT 
    d.driverRef,

FROM driver_min_lap dm

ORDER BY dm.min_time_in_seconds ASC
LIMIT 20

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN inpatient_count > outpatient_count THEN 'in-patient'
        ELSE 'outpatient'
    END as more_male_group,
    ABS(inpatient_count - outpatient_count) * 100.0 / (inpatient_count + outpatient_count) as deviation_percentage
FROM (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(attr_001, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as inpatient_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(attr_001, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as outpatient_count
    FROM Patient 
    WHERE SUBSTR(attr_001, 1, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'M'
) counts

    SUM(CASE WHEN Description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_count,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 
        THEN ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Description IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN Description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2)

WITH creatinine_ranges AS (
  SELECT 
    p.ID,
    p.attr_001 AS gender,
    l.CRE,
    CASE 
      WHEN l.CRE < 0.6 OR l.CRE > 1.2 THEN 'abnormal'
      ELSE 'normal'
    END AS creatinine_status
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.CRE IS NOT NULL
    AND p.attr_001 IN ('male', 'female')
),
gender_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS abnormal_count
  FROM creatinine_ranges
  WHERE creatinine_status = 'abnormal'
  GROUP BY gender
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN 
      (SELECT abnormal_count FROM gender_counts WHERE gender = 'male') >
      (SELECT abnormal_count FROM gender_counts WHERE gender = 'female')
    THEN 'True'
    ELSE 'False'
  END

WITH PatientAge AS (
    SELECT 
        ID,
        CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER) - 
        (CASE 
            WHEN strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', Birthday) THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS Age
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Birthday IS NOT NULL
),
FemalePatients AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE attr_001 = 'female'
),
AbnormalPT AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE PT IS NOT NULL AND PT < 0.8 OR PT > 1.2
),
EligiblePatients AS (
    SELECT pa.ID
    FROM PatientAge pa
    JOIN FemalePatients fp ON pa.ID = fp.ID
    WHERE pa.Age > 55
)
SELECT 
    (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ap.ID IS NOT NULL THEN ep.ID END) * 100.0 / 
     NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ep.ID), 0)) AS Percentage
FROM EligiblePatients ep
LEFT JOIN AbnormalPT ap ON ep.ID = ap.ID

WITH MaxHemoglobin AS (
    SELECT l.ID, l.HGB, l.Date as LabDate
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.HGB = (SELECT MAX(HGB) FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL)
    LIMIT 1
),
ExamData AS (
    SELECT e.ID, e.Diagnosis, e."Examination Date" as ExamDate
    FROM Examination e
    JOIN MaxHemoglobin mh ON e.ID = mh.ID
    WHERE e."Examination Date" IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY ABS(julianday(e."Examination Date") - julianday(mh.LabDate))
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    (julianday(COALESCE(ed.ExamDate, mh.LabDate)) - julianday(p.Description)) / 365.25 as Age,
    ed.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN MaxHemoglobin mh ON p.ID = mh.ID
LEFT JOIN ExamData ed ON p.ID = ed.ID
WHERE p.Description IS NOT NULL

WITH cholesterol_data AS (
  SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', Date) as month,
    "T-CHO" as total_cholesterol
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE ID = (
    SELECT ID 
    FROM Patient 
    WHERE Description = '1959-02-18'
  )
  AND Date BETWEEN '1981-11-01' AND '1981-12-31'
  AND "T-CHO" IS NOT NULL
),
monthly_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    month,
    AVG(total_cholesterol) as avg_chol
  FROM cholesterol_data
  GROUP BY month
),
nov_dec AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN month = '1981-11' THEN avg_chol END) as nov_chol,
    MAX(CASE WHEN month = '1981-12' THEN avg_chol END) as dec_chol
  FROM monthly_avg
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN nov_chol IS NOT NULL AND dec_chol IS NOT NULL 
    THEN ROUND(((nov_chol - dec_chol) * 100.0 / nov_chol), 2)
    ELSE NULL 
  END as decrease_rate
FROM nov_dec

SELECT T1.Description FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60 ORDER BY T1.Description DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(attr_001 || '-' || attr_002) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60
SELECT MAX(attr_001 || '-' || attr_002) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60

SELECT p.Description
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.GPT BETWEEN 0 AND 40
ORDER BY l.GPT DESC
LIMIT 3
SELECT T1.Description FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GPT < 60 ORDER BY T2.GPT DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT (attr_001 || '-' || attr_002) AS Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GPT < 60 ORDER BY T2.GPT DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT (attr_001 || '-' || attr_002) AS Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GPT < 60 ORDER BY T2.GPT DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT MIN(p.Description) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.GLU NOT BETWEEN 60 AND 140
SELECT T1.Description FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GLU > 180 ORDER BY T1.Description ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT MIN(attr_001 || '-' || attr_002) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GLU > 180
SELECT MIN(attr_001 || '-' || attr_002) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GLU > 180
SELECT T1.District FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE SUBSTR(T1.attr_001,INSTR(T1.attr_001,CHAR(31))+1) = 'Active' ORDER BY T2.AvgScrRead DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.CDSCode) FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Merged' AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100 AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'Alameda'

SELECT COUNT(T1.`School Name`) FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE SUBSTR(T2.attr_001,1,INSTR(T2.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'Amador' AND T1.`Low Grade` = '9' AND T1.`High Grade` = '12'

SELECT T1.`School Name`, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE SUBSTR(T2.attr_001,1,INSTR(T2.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'Monterey' AND T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800 AND T1.`School Type` = 'High Schools (Public)'

SELECT T2.Website FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000 AND SUBSTR(T2.attr_001,1,INSTR(T2.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'Los Angeles'

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980' AND SUBSTR(T2.attr_001,1,INSTR(T2.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'Fresno'

SELECT School FROM (SELECT T2.School, T1.AvgScrRead, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY SUBSTR(T2.attr_001,1,INSTR(T2.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Virtual = 'F' ) ranked_schools WHERE rnk <= 5

SELECT T1.AvgScrMath, SUBSTR(T2.attr_001,1,INSTR(T2.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) AS County FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL AND T1.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL AND T1.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath + T1.AvgScrRead + T1.AvgScrWrite ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT CAST(COUNT(School) AS REAL) / 12 FROM schools WHERE DOC = '52' AND SUBSTR(attr_001,1,INSTR(attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'Alameda' AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DOC = '54' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN DOC = '52' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM schools WHERE SUBSTR(attr_001, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Merged' AND SUBSTR(attr_001, 1, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'Orange'

SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTR(attr_001,1,INSTR(attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) AS County, School, ClosedDate FROM schools WHERE SUBSTR(attr_001,1,INSTR(attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = ( SELECT SUBSTR(attr_001,1,INSTR(attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) FROM schools WHERE SUBSTR(attr_001,INSTR(attr_001,CHAR(31))+1) = 'Closed' GROUP BY SUBSTR(attr_001,1,INSTR(attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND SUBSTR(attr_001,INSTR(attr_001,CHAR(31))+1) = 'Closed' AND School IS NOT NULL

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(attr_001,1,INSTR(attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'Colusa' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(attr_001,1,INSTR(attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'Humboldt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM schools WHERE MailState = 'CA'
SELECT COUNT(CDSCode) FROM schools WHERE City = 'San Joaquin' AND MailState = 'CA' AND SUBSTR(attr_001,INSTR(attr_001,CHAR(31))+1) = 'Active'
SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE SUBSTR(attr_001,1,INSTR(attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'San Joaquin' AND Virtual = 'P' AND Charter = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE SUBSTR(T2.attr_001,1,INSTR(T2.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'Los Angeles' AND T2.Charter = 0 AND T1.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` < 0.18

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s.FundingType = 'Locally funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.FundingType != 'Locally funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM schools s WHERE SUBSTR(s.attr_001, 1, INSTR(s.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'Santa Clara' AND s.Charter = 1
SELECT COUNT(School) FROM schools WHERE strftime('%Y', OpenDate) BETWEEN '2000' AND '2005' AND SUBSTR(attr_001,1,INSTR(attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'Stanislaus' AND FundingType = 'Directly funded'

SELECT SUBSTR(attr_001,1,INSTR(attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) AS County FROM schools WHERE strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989' AND SUBSTR(attr_001,INSTR(attr_001,CHAR(31))+1) = 'Closed' AND SOC = 11 GROUP BY County ORDER BY COUNT(School) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(attr_001, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(attr_001, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed_count
FROM schools 
WHERE SOC = '69' 
  AND SUBSTR(attr_001, 1, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'Alpine'

SELECT T2.City FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Lunch Provision 2' AND SUBSTR(T2.attr_001,1,INSTR(T2.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'Merced' AND T1.`Low Grade` = '9' AND T1.`High Grade` = '12' AND T2.EILCode = 'HS'

SELECT T2.School, T1.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)` FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE SUBSTR(T2.attr_001,1,INSTR(T2.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'Los Angeles' AND T2.GSserved = 'K-9'

SELECT SUBSTR(attr_001,1,INSTR(attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) AS County, COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE (SUBSTR(attr_001,1,INSTR(attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'San Diego' OR SUBSTR(attr_001,1,INSTR(attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'Santa Barbara') AND Virtual = 'F' GROUP BY County ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT s.AdmLName1, s.District, SUBSTR(s.attr_001,1,INSTR(s.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) AS County, s.School FROM schools s WHERE s.CharterNum = '0040'

SELECT DISTINCT s.AdmEmail1, s.AdmEmail2, s.AdmEmail3
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE SUBSTR(s.attr_001,1,INSTR(s.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'San Bernardino'
  AND s.City = 'San Bernardino'
  AND s.DOC = '54'
  AND s.OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
  AND (f.`School Type` IN ('Intermediate/Middle School', 'Unified School') OR s.SOC = '62')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.account_id) FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'east Bohemia' AND T2.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.account_id) FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN district AS T3 ON T1.district_id = T3.district_id WHERE SUBSTR(T3.attr_001, INSTR(T3.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Prague'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.client_id) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.gender = 'M' AND SUBSTR(T2.attr_001, INSTR(T2.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'north Bohemia' AND T2.A11 > 8000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.client_id) FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN client AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T2.gender = 'F' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.birth_date) < '1950' AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001,1,INSTR(T1.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'Sokolov'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) FROM client c JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district ds ON a.district_id = ds.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND SUBSTR(ds.attr_001,1,INSTR(ds.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'Jesenik' AND d.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT COUNT(T2.account_id) FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.date) = '1996' AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001,1,INSTR(T1.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'Litomerice'
SELECT SUBSTR(attr_001,1,INSTR(attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) FROM district WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM client WHERE birth_date = '1976-01-29' AND gender = 'F')

SELECT T1.account_id FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE SUBSTR(T2.attr_001, INSTR(T2.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Prague' ORDER BY T1.date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.client_id) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE SUBSTR(T2.attr_001, INSTR(T2.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'south Bohemia' GROUP BY T2.district_id ORDER BY T2.A4 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.account_id, SUBSTR(T2.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T2.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) AS district_name, SUBSTR(T2.attr_001, INSTR(T2.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) AS district_region FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) = '1993'

SELECT T1.account_id, T1.frequency FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE SUBSTR(T2.attr_001, INSTR(T2.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'east Bohemia' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) BETWEEN '1995' AND '2000'
SELECT T1.account_id, T1.date FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE SUBSTR(T2.attr_001,1,INSTR(T2.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'Prachatice'

SELECT SUBSTR(T2.attr_001,1,INSTR(T2.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) AS A2, SUBSTR(T2.attr_001,INSTR(T2.attr_001,CHAR(31))+1) AS A3 FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN loan AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE T3.loan_id = 4990

SELECT T1.account_id, SUBSTR(T2.attr_001,1,INSTR(T2.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) AS A2, SUBSTR(T2.attr_001,INSTR(T2.attr_001,CHAR(31))+1) AS A3 FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN loan AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE T3.amount > 300000

SELECT T3.loan_id, SUBSTR(T2.attr_001,1,INSTR(T2.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) AS district, T2.A11 AS average_salary FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN loan AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE T3.duration = 60

SELECT CAST(SUM(SUBSTR(attr_001,1,INSTR(attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'Decin') AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(account_id) FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.date) = '1993'

SELECT SUBSTR(d.attr_001,1,INSTR(d.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS female_account_holders
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
GROUP BY d.district_id, district_name
ORDER BY female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9

SELECT SUBSTR(d.attr_001,1,INSTR(d.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) AS district_name, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawal
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.date LIKE '1996-01-%'
GROUP BY d.district_id, district_name
ORDER BY total_withdrawal DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T3.account_id) FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN client AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id WHERE SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'south Bohemia' AND T3.type != 'OWNER' AND T3.account_id NOT IN (SELECT disp_id FROM card)

SELECT SUBSTR(attr_001, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN loan AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE T3.status IN ('C', 'D') GROUP BY SUBSTR(attr_001, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) ORDER BY SUM(T3.amount) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT SUBSTR(attr_001,1,INSTR(attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) AS district_name, A4 AS branch_location FROM district ORDER BY A13 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(T1.account_id) FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE SUBSTR(T2.attr_001,1,INSTR(T2.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'Pisek'

SELECT DISTINCT account.account_id
FROM `order`
INNER JOIN account ON `order`.account_id = account.account_id
INNER JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE `order`.k_symbol = 'household payment'
  AND SUBSTR(district.attr_001, 1, INSTR(district.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'Pisek'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.client_id) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.gender = 'F' AND SUBSTR(T2.attr_001, INSTR(T2.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'south Bohemia'

SELECT T2.account_id FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE T3.type = 'OWNER' AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001,1,INSTR(T1.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'Tabor'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.account_id) FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN trans AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE T3.bank = 'AB' AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'north Bohemia'

SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTR(attr_001,1,INSTR(attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN trans AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE T3.type = 'VYDAJ'
SELECT COUNT(T1.client_id) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.gender = 'M' AND SUBSTR(T2.attr_001,1,INSTR(T2.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'Hl.m. Praha'
SELECT SUBSTR(attr_001, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) FROM district WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM client WHERE client_id = 3541)

SELECT SUBSTR(attr_001,1,INSTR(attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN loan AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE T3.status = 'A' GROUP BY T1.district_id ORDER BY COUNT(T2.account_id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(T2.account_id) FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE SUBSTR(T1.attr_001,1,INSTR(T1.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'Jesenik'
SELECT SUM(IIF(SUBSTR(attr_001, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'east Bohemia', A16, 0)) - SUM(IIF(SUBSTR(attr_001, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'north Bohemia', A16, 0)) FROM district

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
INNER JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
INNER JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
INNER JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE SUBSTR(dist.attr_001, INSTR(dist.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'east Bohemia'
  AND strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) BETWEEN '1983' AND '1987'

SELECT COUNT(account_id) FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) > '1996' AND SUBSTR(T2.attr_001,1,INSTR(T2.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'Beroun'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(T2.client_id) * 100 FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN client AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Prague'

SELECT COUNT(T1.client_id) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.birth_date) = '1920' AND SUBSTR(T2.attr_001, INSTR(T2.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'east Bohemia'

SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id, c.district_id
FROM disp d
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM card WHERE card.disp_id = d.disp_id
  )
SELECT SUBSTR(attr_001,1,INSTR(attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 19 ORDER BY T1.q2 ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.q1 FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 354 AND SUBSTR(T2.attr_001, INSTR(T2.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Bruno' AND SUBSTR(T2.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T2.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'Senna'

SELECT SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) AS forename, SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) AS surname FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T2.raceId = 592 AND T2.time IS NOT NULL AND T1.dob IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T1.dob ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTR(d.attr_001, INSTR(d.attr_001, CHAR(31))+1) AS forename, SUBSTR(d.attr_001, 1, INSTR(d.attr_001, CHAR(31))-1) AS surname, d.url FROM lapTimes AS lt INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = lt.driverId WHERE lt.raceId = 161 AND lt.time LIKE '1:27%'

SELECT T1.q1 FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 345 AND SUBSTR(T2.attr_001, INSTR(T2.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Lucas' AND SUBSTR(T2.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T2.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'di Grassi'

SELECT T2.time FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T2.raceId = 743 AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Bruce' AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'McLaren'

SELECT SUBSTR(d.attr_001, INSTR(d.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) AS forename, SUBSTR(d.attr_001, 1, INSTR(d.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) AS surname FROM races AS r INNER JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId WHERE r.year = 2006 AND r.name = 'San Marino Grand Prix' AND res.position = 2

SELECT SUBSTR(d.attr_001, INSTR(d.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) AS forename, SUBSTR(d.attr_001, 1, INSTR(d.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) AS surname FROM drivers AS d INNER JOIN results AS r ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.raceId = 872 AND r.time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.dob DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUBSTR(d.attr_001, INSTR(d.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) || ' ' || SUBSTR(d.attr_001, 1, INSTR(d.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) AS full_name
FROM lapTimes AS lt
INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
WHERE lt.raceId = 348
ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT (SUM(IIF(T2.raceId = 853, T2.fastestLapSpeed, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T2.raceId = 854, T2.fastestLapSpeed, 0))) * 100.0 / SUM(IIF(T2.raceId = 853, T2.fastestLapSpeed, 0)) FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Paul' AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'di Resta'

WITH lap_times_in_seconds AS (
    SELECT 
        driverId, 
        (CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTR(time, 1, INSTR(time, ':') - 1) <> '' 
            THEN CAST(SUBSTR(time, 1, INSTR(time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 
            ELSE 0 
        END + 
        CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, ':') + 1, INSTR(time, '.') - INSTR(time, ':') - 1) <> '' 
            THEN CAST(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, ':') + 1, INSTR(time, '.') - INSTR(time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) 
            ELSE 0 
        END + 
        CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, '.') + 1) <> '' 
            THEN CAST(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS time_in_seconds 
    FROM lapTimes
),
driver_min_lap AS (
    SELECT 
        driverId, 
        MIN(time_in_seconds) AS min_time_in_seconds 
    FROM lap_times_in_seconds 
    GROUP BY driverId
)
SELECT 
    SUBSTR(d.attr_001, INSTR(d.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) AS forename,
    SUBSTR(d.attr_001, 1, INSTR(d.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) AS surname,
    dm.driverId
FROM driver_min_lap dm
INNER JOIN drivers d ON dm.driverId = d.driverId
ORDER BY dm.min_time_in_seconds ASC 
LIMIT 20

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN in_patients > out_patients THEN 'in-patient'
        ELSE 'outpatient'
    END as more_male_group,
    ABS(in_patients - out_patients) * 100.0 / (in_patients + out_patients) as deviation_percentage
FROM (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(attr_001, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as in_patients,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(attr_001, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as out_patients
    FROM Patient 
    WHERE SUBSTR(attr_001, 1, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'M'
) counts

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE (T2.FG <= 150 OR T2.FG >= 450) AND T2.WBC >= 3.5 AND T2.WBC <= 9.0 AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001,1,INSTR(T1.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'M'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE (T2.RNP = 'negative' OR T2.RNP = '0') AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = '+'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T3.ID = T2.ID WHERE (T2.SC170 = 'negative' OR T2.SC170 = '0') AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001,1,INSTR(T1.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'F' AND T3.Symptoms IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CENTROMEA IN ('negative', '0') AND T2.SSB IN ('negative', '0') AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001,1,INSTR(T1.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'M'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGG >= 900 AND T2.IGG <= 2000 AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = '+'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT < 60 AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001,1,INSTR(T1.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'M'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT < 60 AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001,1,INSTR(T1.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'M'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.ALP >= 300 AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = '+'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.ALP < 300 AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = '-'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE SUBSTR(T1.attr_001,1,INSTR(T1.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'M' AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5

SELECT T3.`aCL IgG`, T3.`aCL IgM`, T3.`aCL IgA` FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T3.ID = T2.ID WHERE SUBSTR(T1.attr_001,1,INSTR(T1.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'F' AND T2.UA > 6.5 ORDER BY T2.UA DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9 AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE (T2.RBC <= 3.5 OR T2.RBC >= 6) AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = '-'
SELECT AVG(T2.PT) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.PT < 14 AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001,1,INSTR(T1.attr_001,CHAR(31))-1) = 'M'

SELECT attr_001 || ' ' || attr_002 AS Phone FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded' AND T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 AND T2.OpenDate > '2000-01-01'
SELECT s.attr_001 || ' ' || s.attr_002 FROM satscores AS sat INNER JOIN schools AS s ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode ORDER BY sat.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT (T1.attr_001 || ' ' || T1.attr_002) AS Phone FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds ORDER BY CAST(T2.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / T2.NumTstTakr DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT T1.attr_001 || ' ' || T1.attr_002 FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds ORDER BY T2.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.School, T1.AvgScrWrite, (T2.attr_001 || ' ' || T2.attr_002) AS Phone FROM schools AS T2 LEFT JOIN satscores AS T1 ON T2.CDSCode = T1.cds WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) > '1991' OR strftime('%Y', T2.ClosedDate) < '2000'

SELECT s.attr_001 || ' ' || s.attr_002 AS Phone
FROM satscores AS sat
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.District = 'Fresno Unified'
  AND sat.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sat.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT attr_001 || ' ' || attr_002 AS Phone, Ext FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC LIMIT 332, 1
SELECT attr_001 || ' ' || attr_002 AS Phone, Ext, School FROM schools WHERE Zip = '95203-3704'

SELECT T1.account_id, (SELECT MAX(A11) - MIN(A11) FROM district) AS salary_gap
FROM account AS T1
INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id
INNER JOIN client AS T4 ON T3.client_id = T4.client_id
WHERE T2.district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
    ORDER BY (attr_001 || '-' || attr_002) ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY T2.A11 ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
INNER JOIN client AS T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id
INNER JOIN district AS T4 ON T4.district_id = T1.district_id
WHERE T3.client_id = (
    SELECT client_id
    FROM client
    ORDER BY (attr_001 || '-' || attr_002) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
GROUP BY T4.A11, T1.account_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.client_id) FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN client AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T2.gender = 'F' AND (T2.attr_001 || '-' || T2.attr_002) < '1950-01-01' AND T1.A2 = 'Sokolov'

SELECT c.gender
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN account a ON c.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A11 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY (c.attr_001 || '-' || c.attr_002) ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.A2 FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN client AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE (T2.attr_001 || '-' || T2.attr_002) = '1976-1-29' AND T2.gender = 'F'

SELECT T4.attr_001 || '-' || T4.attr_002 AS birth_date FROM loan AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id INNER JOIN client AS T4 ON T3.client_id = T4.client_id WHERE T1.date = '1996-01-03' AND T1.amount = 98832

SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', attr_001 || '-' || attr_002) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T1.client_id = T3.client_id INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T3.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE T2.account_id = 130

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, a.account_id
FROM client c
INNER JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
INNER JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
INNER JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND (c.attr_001 || '-' || c.attr_002) BETWEEN '1983-01-01' AND '1987-12-31'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T3.client_id) FROM trans AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN disp AS T4 ON T2.account_id = T4.account_id INNER JOIN client AS T3 ON T4.client_id = T3.client_id WHERE (T3.attr_001 || '-' || T3.attr_002) BETWEEN '1974-01-01' AND '1976-12-31' AND T3.gender = 'M' AND T1.amount > 4000 AND T1.k_symbol = 'SIPO'

SELECT T3.account_id FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id INNER JOIN disp AS T4 ON T1.client_id = T4.client_id AND T4.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE T1.gender = 'F' ORDER BY (T1.attr_001 || '-' || T1.attr_002) ASC, T2.A11 ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(T1.client_id) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, 4) = '1920' AND T2.A3 = 'east Bohemia'

SELECT T1.client_id, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T3.attr_001 || '-' || T3.attr_002) FROM disp AS T1 INNER JOIN card AS T2 ON T2.disp_id = T1.disp_id INNER JOIN client AS T3 ON T1.client_id = T3.client_id WHERE T2.type = 'gold' AND T1.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM drivers AS d INNER JOIN results AS r ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.raceId = 592 AND r.time IS NOT NULL AND d.attr_001 IS NOT NULL AND d.attr_002 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (d.attr_001 || '-' || d.attr_002) ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.forename, T1.surname FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T2.raceId = 872 AND T2.time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (T1.attr_001 || '-' || T1.attr_002) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', attr_001 || '-' || attr_002), forename, surname FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'Japanese' ORDER BY attr_001 || '-' || attr_002 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT nationality FROM drivers WHERE attr_001 IS NOT NULL AND attr_002 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (attr_001 || '-' || attr_002) ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(driverId) FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'British' AND (attr_001 || '-' || attr_002) > '1980-00-00' AND (attr_001 || '-' || attr_002) IS NOT NULL
SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE (d.attr_001 || '-' || d.attr_002) > '1975' AND r.rank = 2

SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF((T3.attr_001 || '-' || T3.attr_002) < '1985-01-01' AND T1.laps > 50, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 on T1.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 on T1.driverId = T3.driverId WHERE T2.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT nationality FROM drivers ORDER BY JULIANDAY(attr_001 || '-' || attr_002) DESC LIMIT 3) AS youngest_drivers WHERE nationality = 'Dutch'
SELECT COUNT(driverId) FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'British' AND (attr_001 || '-' || attr_002) LIKE '1980-%'

SELECT d.driverId FROM drivers d INNER JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.driverId = lt.driverId WHERE d.nationality = 'German' AND (d.attr_001 || '-' || d.attr_002) BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1990-12-31' ORDER BY lt.milliseconds LIMIT 3
SELECT driverRef FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'German' ORDER BY (attr_001 || '-' || attr_002) ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.driverId, T2.code FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE (T2.attr_001 || '-' || T2.attr_002) LIKE '1971-%' AND T1.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL

SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, MAX(l.time) AS latest_lap_time
FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes l ON d.driverId = l.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'Spanish' AND (d.attr_001 || '-' || d.attr_002) < '1982-01-01'
GROUP BY d.driverId
ORDER BY latest_lap_time DESC
LIMIT 10
SELECT T2.driverRef, T2.nationality, T2.attr_001 || '-' || T2.attr_002 AS dob FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 23 AND T1.q2 IS NOT NULL

SELECT T3.year, T3.name, T3.date, T3.time FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 on T1.driverId = T2.driverId INNER JOIN races AS T3 on T1.raceId = T3.raceId WHERE T1.driverId = ( SELECT driverId FROM drivers ORDER BY (attr_001 || '-' || attr_002) DESC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY T3.date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT d.forename, d.surname 
FROM pitStops ps 
INNER JOIN drivers d ON ps.driverId = d.driverId 
WHERE d.nationality = 'German' 
  AND (d.attr_001 || '-' || d.attr_002) BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1985-12-31' 
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname 
ORDER BY AVG(ps.milliseconds) 
LIMIT 3
SELECT forename, surname, attr_001 || '-' || attr_002 AS dob FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'Austrian' AND attr_001 BETWEEN '1981' AND '1991'

SELECT forename || ' ' || surname AS full_name, url, attr_001 || '-' || attr_002 AS dob FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'German' AND CAST(SUBSTR(attr_001, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1971 AND 1985 ORDER BY dob DESC

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name, d.nationality, r.name AS first_race_name
FROM drivers d
INNER JOIN results res ON d.driverId = res.driverId
INNER JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE (d.attr_001 IS NOT NULL AND d.attr_002 IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY (SUBSTR(d.attr_001, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(d.attr_002, 1, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(d.attr_002, 3, 2)) DESC, r.date ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(ds.wins), d.forename, d.surname 
FROM driverStandings AS ds 
INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId 
ORDER BY (d.attr_001 || '-' || d.attr_002) ASC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.event_id) FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN member AS T3 ON T2.link_to_member = T3.member_id WHERE T3.first_name = 'Sacha' AND T3.last_name = 'Harrison' AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001 || '-' || T1.attr_002, 1, 4) = '2019'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(T2.link_to_event) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T2.link_to_event) FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE SUBSTR(T1.attr_001 || '-' || T1.attr_002, 1, 4) = '2020' AND T1.type = 'Meeting'

SELECT T2.spent FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.event_name = 'September Meeting' AND T2.category = 'Food' AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001 || '-' || T1.attr_002, 6, 2) = '09'

SELECT T2.spent FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.event_name = 'September Meeting' AND T2.category = 'Advertisement' AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001 || '-' || T1.attr_002, 6, 2) = '09'

SELECT T3.approved FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget WHERE T1.event_name = 'October Meeting' AND (T1.attr_001 || '-' || T1.attr_002) LIKE '2019-10-08%'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(attr_001 || '-' || attr_002, 1, 4) = '2019' THEN T2.spent ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(attr_001 || '-' || attr_002, 1, 4) = '2020' THEN T2.spent ELSE 0 END) AS num FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event
SELECT COUNT(event_id) FROM event WHERE type = 'Meeting' AND SUBSTR(attr_001 || '-' || attr_002, 1, 4) = '2020'

SELECT COUNT(T2.link_to_member) FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.event_name = 'Community Theater' AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001 || '-' || T1.attr_002, 1, 4) = '2019'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Community Service' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(type) FROM event WHERE SUBSTR(attr_001 || '-' || attr_002, 1, 4) = '2019'
SELECT T2.category FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.attr_001 || '-' || T1.attr_002 = '2020-03-24T12:00:00'
SELECT DISTINCT event_name FROM event WHERE type = 'game' AND date(attr_001 || '-' || attr_002) BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20' AND status = 'Closed'
SELECT event_id, location, status FROM event WHERE date(attr_001 || '-' || attr_002) BETWEEN '2019-11-01' AND '2020-03-31'

SELECT T1.event_name, T1.attr_001 || '-' || T1.attr_002 AS event_date FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget WHERE T3.expense_description = 'Pizza' AND T3.cost > 50 AND T3.cost < 100
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN (attr_001 || '-' || attr_002) > '1930' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE (attr_001 || '-' || attr_002) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940'
SELECT T1.SEX, T1.attr_001 || '-' || T1.attr_002 AS Birthday, T2.`Examination Date`, T2.Symptoms FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.ID = 163109
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.attr_001 || '-' || T1.attr_002 AS Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH > 500
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.attr_001 || '-' || T1.attr_002) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RVVT = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE (T1.attr_001 || '-' || T1.attr_002) LIKE '1937-%' AND T2.`T-CHO` >= 250

SELECT AVG(T2.`aCL IgG`) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(SUBSTR(T1.attr_002, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) >= 50 AND T1.Admission = '+'
SELECT MIN(STRFTIME('%Y', `First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', (attr_001 || '-' || attr_002))) FROM Patient
SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', MAX(attr_001 || '-' || attr_002)) - STRFTIME('%Y', MIN(attr_001 || '-' || attr_002)) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.TG >= 200
SELECT T2.Symptoms, T2.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (T1.attr_001 || '-' || T1.attr_002) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.Date, (STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', (T2.attr_001 || '-' || T2.attr_002))) AS Age FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS' AND T2.attr_001 IS NOT NULL AND T2.attr_002 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (T2.attr_001 || '-' || T2.attr_002) ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1993' AND (STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) - (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + CAST(SUBSTR(T1.attr_002, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) / 100.0)) < 18
SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(SUBSTR(attr_001 || '-' || attr_002, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-31'
SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.attr_001 || '-' || T1.attr_002), T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID ORDER BY T2.HGB DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.attr_001 || '-' || T1.attr_002) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.UA = 8.4 AND T2.Date = '1991-10-21'
SELECT T2.Symptoms FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE (T1.attr_001 || '-' || T1.attr_002) = '1959-03-01' AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-09-27'

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN T2.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN T2.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END)) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN T2.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.attr_001 || '-' || T1.attr_002 = '1959-2-18'
SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Admission = '+' AND (attr_001 || '-' || attr_002) LIKE '1964-%'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`ANA Pattern` != 'P' AND (SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989' OR SUBSTR(T1.attr_002, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989') AND T1.SEX = 'F'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'RA' AND (attr_001 || '-' || attr_002) LIKE '1980-%'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.SEX, (T1.attr_001 || '-' || T1.attr_002) AS Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT < 60 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) = '1994'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GPT > 60 ORDER BY (T1.attr_001 || '-' || T1.attr_002) ASC

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.attr_001 || '-' || T1.attr_002) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH > 600 AND T2.LDH < 800
SELECT T1.ID, CASE WHEN T2.ALP < 300 THEN 'normal' ELSE 'abNormal' END FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE (T1.attr_001 || '-' || T1.attr_002) = '1982-04-01'
SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.attr_001 || '-' || Patient.attr_002 AS Birthday FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.TP < 6.0
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5) ORDER BY (T1.attr_001 || '-' || T1.attr_002) DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN T2.ALB >= 3.5 AND T2.ALB <= 5.5 THEN 'normal' ELSE 'abnormal' END FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.attr_001 || '-' || T1.attr_002) = '1982'

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, (P.attr_001 || '-' || P.attr_002) AS Birthday
FROM Patient AS P

FROM customers AS T1

    Segment,
    ((SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2013' THEN yearmonth_consumption ELSE 0 END) - 
      SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2012' THEN yearmonth_consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / 
     NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2012' THEN yearmonth_consumption ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS percentage_increase
FROM customers 
INNER JOIN yearmonth ON customers.CustomerID = yearmonth.CustomerID
WHERE customers_currency = 'EUR' 
  AND (strftime('%Y', Date) = '2012' OR strftime('%Y', Date) = '2013')
  AND Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
GROUP BY Segment
ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC

WITH lap_times_in_seconds AS (
    SELECT driverId, 
           (CASE 
                WHEN SUBSTR(time, 1, INSTR(time, ':') - 1) <> '' 
                THEN CAST(SUBSTR(time, 1, INSTR(time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 
                ELSE 0 
            END + 
            CASE 
                WHEN SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, ':') + 1, INSTR(time, '.') - INSTR(time, ':') - 1) <> '' 
                THEN CAST(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, ':') + 1, INSTR(time, '.') - INSTR(time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) 
                ELSE 0 
            END + 
            CASE 
                WHEN SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, '.') + 1) <> '' 
                THEN CAST(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000 
                ELSE 0 
            END) AS time_in_seconds 
    FROM lapTimes
)
SELECT d.driverRef, T1.driverId 
FROM (
    SELECT driverId, MIN(time_in_seconds) AS min_time_in_seconds 
    FROM lap_times_in_seconds 
    GROUP BY driverId
) AS T1 
INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON T1.driverId = d.driverId 
ORDER BY T1.min_time_in_seconds ASC 
LIMIT 20

WITH lap_times_in_seconds AS (
    SELECT 
        driverId, 
        (CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTR(time, 1, INSTR(time, ':') - 1) <> '' 
            THEN CAST(SUBSTR(time, 1, INSTR(time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 
            ELSE 0 
        END + 
        CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, ':') + 1, INSTR(time, '.') - INSTR(time, ':') - 1) <> '' 
            THEN CAST(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, ':') + 1, INSTR(time, '.') - INSTR(time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) 
            ELSE 0 
        END + 
        CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, '.') + 1) <> '' 
            THEN CAST(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS time_in_seconds 
    FROM lapTimes
),
driver_min_lap AS (
    SELECT 
        driverId, 
        MIN(time_in_seconds) AS min_time_in_seconds 
    FROM lap_times_in_seconds 
    GROUP BY driverId
)

SELECT T1.District FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Active' ORDER BY T2.AvgScrRead DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT School FROM (SELECT T2.School, T1.AvgScrRead, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY substr(T2.attr_001, 1, instr(T2.attr_001, char(31)) - 1) ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Virtual = 'F' ) ranked_schools WHERE rnk <= 5
SELECT COUNT(CDSCode) FROM schools WHERE City = 'San Joaquin' AND MailState = 'CA' AND SUBSTR(attr_001, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Active'

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(attr_001, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(attr_001, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed_count
FROM schools 
WHERE SOC = '69' 
  AND SUBSTR(attr_001, 1, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'Alpine'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client.client_id) FROM client JOIN account ON client.district_id = account.district_id JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.gender = 'F' AND substr(district.attr_001, 1, instr(district.attr_001, char(31)) - 1) = 'Jesenik'

SELECT T1.account_id, T1.frequency FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE SUBSTR(T2.attr_001, INSTR(T2.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'east Bohemia' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) BETWEEN '1995' AND '2000'

SELECT SUBSTR(d.attr_001, 1, INSTR(d.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS female_account_holders
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
GROUP BY d.district_id, district_name
ORDER BY female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9

SELECT DISTINCT T2.account_id FROM trans AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN district AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id WHERE T1.k_symbol = 'household payment' AND substr(T3.attr_001, 1, instr(T3.attr_001, char(31)) - 1) = 'Pisek'
SELECT SUBSTR(attr_001, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) FROM district WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM client WHERE client_id = 3541)

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(T2.client_id) * 100 FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN client AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Prague'

SELECT T2.time FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T2.raceId = 743 AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'Bruce' AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'McLaren'

SELECT 
    substr(d.attr_001, 1, instr(d.attr_001, char(31)) - 1) AS forename,
    substr(d.attr_001, instr(d.attr_001, char(31)) + 1) AS surname,
    SUM(ds.points) AS total_points
FROM driverStandings ds
JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId
GROUP BY ds.driverId
ORDER BY total_points DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', dob), SUBSTR(attr_001, 1, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'Japanese' ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT SUBSTR(attr_001, 1, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) AS surname FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'Italian'

SELECT T1.name FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE SUBSTR(T3.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T3.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'Hamilton' AND SUBSTR(T3.attr_001, INSTR(T3.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Lewis'

SELECT 
    substr(d.attr_001, instr(d.attr_001, char(31)) + 1) AS forename,
    substr(d.attr_001, 1, instr(d.attr_001, char(31)) - 1) AS surname,
    d.url
FROM drivers AS d
INNER JOIN results AS r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
INNER JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE ra.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' 
  AND ra.year = 2008
  AND r.positionOrder = 1

SELECT 
    substr(d.attr_001, instr(d.attr_001, char(31)) + 1) AS forename,
    substr(d.attr_001, 1, instr(d.attr_001, char(31)) - 1) AS surname
FROM pitStops ps
JOIN drivers d ON ps.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'German' 
  AND strftime('%Y', d.dob) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1985'
GROUP BY d.driverId
ORDER BY avg(ps.milliseconds) 
LIMIT 3

SELECT SUM(ds.wins), 
       SUBSTR(d.attr_001, 1, INSTR(d.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) AS forename,
       SUBSTR(d.attr_001, INSTR(d.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) AS surname
FROM driverStandings ds
INNER JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId
ORDER BY d.dob ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(milliseconds) FROM pitStops AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 on T1.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE SUBSTR(T2.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T2.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'Hamilton' AND SUBSTR(T2.attr_001, INSTR(T2.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Lewis'

SELECT T1.event_name FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN member AS T3 ON T2.link_to_member = T3.member_id WHERE SUBSTR(T3.attr_001, INSTR(T3.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Maya' AND SUBSTR(T3.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T3.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'Mclean'

SELECT SUBSTR(attr_001, 1, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) AS last_name, SUBSTR(attr_001, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) AS first_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T1.zip = T2.zip_code WHERE T2.state = 'Illinois'

SELECT T2.type FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T1.zip = T2.zip_code WHERE SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'Nielson' AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Christof'

SELECT 
    substr(T1.attr_001, instr(T1.attr_001, char(31)) + 1) AS first_name,
    substr(T1.attr_001, 1, instr(T1.attr_001, char(31)) - 1) AS last_name
FROM member AS T1 
INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id 
WHERE T2.department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education'

SELECT SUBSTR(T4.attr_001, INSTR(T4.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) AS first_name, SUBSTR(T4.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T4.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) AS last_name FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget INNER JOIN member AS T4 ON T3.link_to_member = T4.member_id WHERE T1.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff'

SELECT T2.expense_description FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'Harrison' AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Sacha'

SELECT 
    substr(attr_001, 1, instr(attr_001, char(31)) - 1) AS last_name,
    substr(attr_001, instr(attr_001, char(31)) + 1) AS first_name
FROM member
WHERE t_shirt_size = 'X-Large'

SELECT SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) AS last_name, T1.phone FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T2.major_id = T1.link_to_major WHERE T2.major_name = 'Elementary Education'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(attr_001, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(attr_001, 1, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'F' AND (TP < 6.0 OR TP > 8.5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE SUBSTR(attr_001, 1, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'F'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = '+' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.`First Date`) >= 1

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = '-' AND T2.`T-BIL` < 2.0 AND T2.Date LIKE '1991-10-%'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'Behcet' 
  AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'M' 
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997' 
  AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = '-'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, 
       SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) AS SEX, 
       T1.Birthday 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.TP < 6.0

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) AS SEX, T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.UN < 30 AND T1.Diagnosis = 'RA'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CPK < 250 AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = '-'

SELECT T1.ID, SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) AS SEX FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T2.HGB > 10 AND T2.HGB < 17 ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.IGG BETWEEN 901 AND 1999 
  AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = '+'

SELECT T3.`aCL IgG`, T3.`aCL IgM`, T3.`aCL IgA` FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T3.ID = T2.ID WHERE SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'F' AND T2.UA > 6.5 ORDER BY T2.UA DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.CDSCode) FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'Alameda' AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Merged' AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100

SELECT T1.AvgScrMath, substr(T2.attr_001, 1, instr(T2.attr_001, char(31)) - 1) AS County FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL AND T1.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL AND T1.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath + T1.AvgScrRead + T1.AvgScrWrite ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE SUBSTR(attr_001, 1, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'San Joaquin' AND Virtual = 'P' AND Charter = 1

SELECT T2.City FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Lunch Provision 2' AND substr(T2.attr_001, 1, instr(T2.attr_001, char(31)) - 1) = 'Merced' AND T1.`Low Grade` = '9' AND T1.`High Grade` = '12' AND T2.EILCode = 'HS'

SELECT COUNT(T2.account_id) FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.date) = '1996' AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'Litomerice'
SELECT T1.account_id, T1.date FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE substr(T2.attr_001, 1, instr(T2.attr_001, char(31)) - 1) = 'Prachatice'

SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTR(d.attr_001, 1, INSTR(d.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) AS district_name
FROM district d
INNER JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
INNER JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date >= '1996-01-01'
  AND t.date < '1996-02-01'
ORDER BY district_name ASC
LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.client_id) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.gender = 'F' AND SUBSTR(T2.attr_001, INSTR(T2.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'south Bohemia'

SELECT SUBSTR(attr_001, 1, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) FROM district WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM account WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan WHERE status = 'A') GROUP BY district_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT COUNT(T1.client_id) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.birth_date) = '1920' AND SUBSTR(T2.attr_001, INSTR(T2.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'east Bohemia'

SELECT SUBSTR(attr_001, 1, INSTR(attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 19 AND T1.q2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T1.q2 ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    SUBSTR(T3.attr_001, INSTR(T3.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) AS forename,
    SUBSTR(T3.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T3.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) AS surname 
FROM races AS T1 
INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId 
INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId 
WHERE T1.year = 2006 
    AND T1.name = 'San Marino Grand Prix' 
    AND T2.position = 2

SELECT 
    SUBSTR(T3.attr_001, INSTR(T3.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) AS forename,
    SUBSTR(T3.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T3.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) AS surname,
    T2.points 
FROM races AS T1 
INNER JOIN driverStandings AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId 
INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId 
WHERE T1.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND T1.year = 2017 
ORDER BY T2.points DESC 
LIMIT 3

SELECT T1.name FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN driverStandings AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE SUBSTR(T3.attr_001, INSTR(T3.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Alex' AND SUBSTR(T3.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T3.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'Yoong' AND T2.position < 20
SELECT url FROM drivers WHERE substr(attr_001, 1, instr(attr_001, char(31)) - 1) = 'Davidson' AND substr(attr_001, instr(attr_001, char(31)) + 1) = 'Anthony'

SELECT r.name 
FROM races r 
WHERE r.raceId IN (
    SELECT res.raceId 
    FROM results res 
    JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId 
    WHERE res.rank = 1 
    AND d.attr_001 LIKE '%' || CHAR(31) || 'Lewis' || CHAR(31) || '%'
)

SELECT SUM(T2.points) FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'Lewis' AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Hamilton'

SELECT 
    substr(attr_001, 1, instr(attr_001, char(31)) - 1) AS surname,
    substr(attr_001, instr(attr_001, char(31)) + 1) AS forename,
    dob 
FROM drivers 
WHERE nationality = 'Austrian' 
    AND CAST(strftime('%Y', dob) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1981 AND 1991

SELECT MAX(T1.milliseconds) FROM pitStops AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE SUBSTR(T2.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T2.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'Hamilton' AND SUBSTR(T2.attr_001, INSTR(T2.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Lewis'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.event_id) FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN member AS T3 ON T2.link_to_member = T3.member_id WHERE SUBSTR(T3.attr_001, INSTR(T3.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Sacha' AND SUBSTR(T3.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T3.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'Harrison' AND SUBSTR(T1.event_date, 1, 4) = '2019'
SELECT DISTINCT T2.department FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) IN ('Pierce', 'Guidi')

SELECT T2.state FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T1.zip = T2.zip_code WHERE SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'Harrison' AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Sacha'

SELECT 
    substr(m.attr_001, instr(m.attr_001, char(31)) + 1) AS first_name,
    substr(m.attr_001, 1, instr(m.attr_001, char(31)) - 1) AS last_name
FROM member AS m
INNER JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
GROUP BY a.link_to_member
HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_event) > 7

SELECT 
    substr(m.attr_001, instr(m.attr_001, char(31)) + 1) AS first_name,
    substr(m.attr_001, 1, instr(m.attr_001, char(31)) - 1) AS last_name,
    i.source
FROM member AS m
INNER JOIN income AS i ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member
GROUP BY m.member_id, i.source
ORDER BY SUM(i.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.major_name FROM major AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.major_id = T2.link_to_major WHERE SUBSTR(T2.attr_001, INSTR(T2.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = 'Phillip' AND SUBSTR(T2.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T2.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'Cullen'

SELECT DISTINCT 
    substr(m.attr_001, 1, instr(m.attr_001, char(31)) - 1) AS last_name,
    substr(m.attr_001, instr(m.attr_001, char(31)) + 1) AS first_name,
    maj.major_name
FROM member m
INNER JOIN major maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id
INNER JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
WHERE e.cost > 100

SELECT 
    SUBSTR(T3.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T3.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) AS last_name,
    SUBSTR(T3.attr_001, INSTR(T3.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) AS first_name,
    T4.amount
FROM 
    income AS T4
INNER JOIN 
    member AS T3 ON T4.link_to_member = T3.member_id
WHERE 
    T4.date_received = '2019-09-09'

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(attr_001, instr(attr_001, char(31)) + 1) = '+' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(attr_001, instr(attr_001, char(31)) + 1) = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
FROM Patient 
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT AVG(E.`aCL IgG`) FROM Patient AS P INNER JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID WHERE (JULIANDAY('now') - JULIANDAY(P.Birthday)) / 365.25 >= 50 AND SUBSTR(P.attr_001, INSTR(P.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = '+'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'M'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`ANA Pattern` != 'P' AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'F' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.WBC < 3.5 AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'F'
SELECT T2.TP - 8.5 FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'F' AND T2.TP > 8.5
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'M'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956' AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'M' AND T2.CPK >= 250

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.PT >= 14 AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) > 55
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT < 60 AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, 1, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) - 1) = 'M'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9 AND SUBSTR(T1.attr_001, INSTR(T1.attr_001, CHAR(31)) + 1) = '+'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Amador' AND "Low Grade" = '9' AND "High Grade" = '12'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Amador' AND "Low Grade" = '9' AND "High Grade" = '12'

SELECT satscores.AvgScrMath, schools.region
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.cds = (
    SELECT cds
    FROM satscores
    WHERE rtype = 'S'
    ORDER BY (AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) / 3.0 ASC
    LIMIT 1

    JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode

      AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
      AND f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` IS NOT NULL
),
EnrollmentDifferences AS (
    SELECT institution, DOCType, 
           (`Enrollment (K-12)` - `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS enrollment_diff
    FROM LocallyFundedSchools

)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.Match_Id) 
FROM Ball_by_Ball b 
JOIN Match m ON b.Match_Id = m.Match_Id 
JOIN Team t ON (m.Team_1 = t.Team_Id OR m.Team_2 = t.Team_Id) 
WHERE t."attr_001" = 'Delhi Daredevils' 
  AND b.Team_Batting = t.Team_Id 
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM Batsman_Scored bs 
    WHERE bs.Match_Id = b.Match_Id 
      AND bs.Innings_No = b.Innings_No 
      AND bs.Runs_Scored > 0
  )

INNER JOIN Match AS T3 ON T2.Match_Id = T3.Match_Id 
INNER JOIN Team AS T4 ON (T3.Team_1 = T4.Team_Id OR T3.Team_2 = T4.Team_Id) 
WHERE T4.attr_001 || ' ' || T4.attr_002 = 'Delhi Daredevils' 
  AND T2.Team_Batting = T4.Team_Id 
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM Batsman_Scored AS T1 
    WHERE T1.Match_Id = T2.Match_Id 
      AND T1.Innings_No = T2.Innings_No 
      AND T1.Runs_Scored > 0
  ) 
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM Extra_Runs AS T5 
    WHERE T5.Match_Id = T2.Match_Id 
      AND T5.Innings_No = T2.Innings_No 
      AND T5.Extra_Runs > 0
  )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match WHERE Match_Winner = (SELECT Team_Id FROM Team WHERE "attr_001" = 'Mumbai Indians') AND strftime('%Y', Match_Date) = '2008'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT M.Match_Id) 
FROM Match M 
JOIN Team T ON M.Match_Winner = T.Team_Id 
WHERE (T.attr_001 || ' ' || T.attr_002) = 'Mumbai Indians' 
  AND M.Match_Date LIKE '2008%'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT M.Match_Id) 
FROM Match M 
JOIN Team T ON M.Match_Winner = T.Team_Id 
WHERE (T.attr_001 || ' ' || T.attr_002) = 'Mumbai Indians' 
  AND M.Match_Date LIKE '2008%'
